Maya (design): Quick notes from a11y pairing on playground tool-calling outputs. Found a few small fixes we should ship before the next release.
Omar (devex): Please bullet them.
Maya (design): 1) Collapse long JSON into a compact row with up to 3 key:value chips; 2) replace "Expand JSON" with "Show structured output"; 3) ensure copy tooltip reads 'Copy output as JSON'.
Priya (eng): Implementation plan: compact renderer for objects <= 5 keys, title tooltip with full value, stable list keys to avoid DOM jumps.
Alex (a11y): Accessibility: chips should be buttons with role="button", visible focus ring, Enter/E toggles flyout. Flyout must receive focus and announce "Run details opened" via aria-live polite. Add aria-controls/aria-expanded on toggles.
Maya (design): Also global copy: unify toolbar copy label to "Run" (we have stray "Invoke" in one spot).
Omar (devex): Add a user preference default_output_view: compact|raw and telemetry events: output_view_change, output_expand, output_copy.
devex-bot: PR opened by priya: https://git.redwood/infer/pulls/460 (WIP)
Priya (eng): ETA: small PR today, feature flag for new behavior. I'll include unit tests for focus restore.
Maya (design): I'll attach a micro-mock in Figma and post copy diffs.
Alex (a11y): I'll run SR pass on the PR when it's up.
Omar (devex): Thanks all, assigning Priya (impl), Alex (a11y review), Maya (copy). We'll measure expand and copy rates after launch.
